research_question: Does a pre-target rolling 100-draw main-number concentration regime (HHI versus the median of 200 earlier rolling HHI windows) provide conditional number-inclusion information for a three-line disjoint union18 portfolio versus the exact geometry-matched null?
novelty_statement: Global rolling draw-frequency concentration regime is distinct from previous-draw categorical state, lag-two membership, pair/neighbor/bonus transitions, B-ticket agreement geometry, and trailing model-performance selection. One fixed regime definition, one Beta-smoothed estimator, one frozen E045 selector; no variants or tuning.

feature_definition.source: For target t, calculate main-number inclusion concentration using only the six main numbers in draws t-100..t-1; exclude bonus numbers.
feature_definition.concentration_metric: HHI=sum_n((count_n/600)^2) over all 45 main-number inclusion frequencies in the immediately preceding 100 draws.
feature_definition.classification: HIGH when current HHI is greater than or equal to the median of the preceding 200 rolling-100-draw HHI values; otherwise LOW.
feature_definition.historical_outcome_regime: For outcome u, classify using draws u-100..u-1 and HHI reference windows ending u-300..u-101; all inputs precede outcome u.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.
feature_definition.training_rule: At target t, use only historical outcomes u=301..t-1. Each historical outcome u is assigned its regime from information through u-1, then contributes to that regime's number-inclusion counts.

estimator.prior_mean: 6/45 main-number inclusion probability under the uniform 6-of-45 null

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E054 regime-conditional score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

exact_null.overlapping_ticket_rule: Compute exact target-specific null preserving actual number-to-line incidence geometry; do not reuse union18 constants.
